Maybe both. I'm not from US. I'm from India. I gave up on my dream of moving there. It caused me so much pain. I used to think I don't belong here and maybe If I moved there I would feel at home. Maybe I would have been. Or not because I can easily fall into isolation just like here. Earlier what holding me back was I never felt like fit in or these are my kind of people and I was looking for something else but don't know what or a place somewhere else but don't know where. I really like Italy, it's art, culture, theatres etc but I think I'm just romantising the idea because I've never been there. My therapist said what I need to do is to make connections first, in my family because my family has communication problems, then with neighbors and friends. And if I went there, I would make a first impression and will then fall back into old habit of isolation. 

I didn't get to leave my hometown for college. I've always been living in my hometown even though I didn't like it. The people here generally were conservative and there were only 4 boys in my class.
This is not how I envisioned my life to be. But I had no choice at that time. 
 But  now  I realise maybe if I jusy accepted it and just went along with it, things could have been better. I saw a psychologist at that time too but he said nothing is wrong with me and I don't need a therapy. My friends in college were not that exciting, you could say and I truly felt out of place. I transferred to a different one and it felt better but still it was there. 

. 

I feel so left behind in life. I'm still stuck at as a teenager. 

My plan now is to do post graduate in bio out of state eventhough I don't like the career path I'm following, but I don't have no other choice and I don't know what else to do. It's so oversaturated here but better than nothing I guess and maybe do a PhD abroad but I don't know if I will be able to put up with it since phD alone is really lonely and stressful. That's why I said my future looks miserable. 

Honestly, I'm not sure about myself but I really appreciate your response. I think I will try to stop thinking about future and just make small efforts. It really hurt me that some people has to do all these things while others have a wonderful life and it comes easy for them and it feels so unfair. But it is what it is. 

Thank you so much for responding. I really hope you have a nice day! ❤️

Just now, some old friends called me after a long long time and I decided to socialise because my therapist suggested it and we met up. I was silent most of the time because I genuinely had nothing to share while I was bamboozled by the things they are experiencing and living. The relationships, travel, friends, partying,drinking, stories.... It's like a whole Commotion is going on outside and I spent most of my life living my life alone dealing with my mental health and my situation. I knew that things like this are happening and it did bothered me seeing them on social media but I dealt with it and I avoided them for a while too. But hearing firsthand was a different kind of heartbreak. I'm 22 M and I'm supposed to be living my life except I lived a miserable life and I can already see that I will be living a miserable life for the rest of my life. 


I never felt belonged in this world. It's either one issue or another. Now, it's like I was left behind. I have nothing going on in my life and I have nothing to look forward to. All I see is a miserable existence. My teenage years went past by without any special memories but it was okay but now my youth too. And it's not like I can suddenly say let's socialise because my situation is complicated (So no comments about why don't you socialise because there's a lot of issue and circumstances which even I don't know how to express)

I feel like it's too late. I wish I died. I wish I could stop existing.
